body.name: IAM
body.description: Roles and Groups. People request, review, grant and remove access, and manage eligible and active privileged roles. Effective assignments always come from the protected Access source.

permissions.label: Request access
permissions.description: Allows creating and submitting access requests.

permissions.label: Manage IAM
permissions.description: Administrative management of the IAM application.

text.value: Change your own display name, language and time zone. Changing another person's profile needs the manage-accounts permission. Each change runs under your own authority in protected Access and is checked against the revision you read.

Access requests describe intent; approval decisions are made by workflows. Only protected Access determines current people, roles, groups and assignments; those views read live protected Access data and are never copied into records.
Read live from protected Identity and Access data under your current authority; nothing is copied into application records.

Revise a role's label and description, create an empty Group, rename a Group, add or remove a Group membership, or end a role, Group or Group membership. Each change runs under your own authority in protected Access, is checked against the revision you read, and is refused if you lack the authority or if it exceeds your delegated scope.

Assign or end a role assignment, deactivate a role activation, or revoke a delegation authority. Each change runs under your own authority in protected Access, is checked against the revision you read, and is refused if you lack the authority or if it exceeds your delegated scope.
Privileged roles the current person may activate are not yet available from a protected read model.
Privileged roles currently active for the current person are not yet available from a protected read model.
